nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable contract; controls authorization for owner-only functions.
Ownable constructor that sets the deployer as the initial owner.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to a new address.
Untrusted caller address used to initialize the owner state variable.
Privileged state write owner = msg.sender performed inside the constructor.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership, the address that receives ownership.
require(msg.sender == owner) guard implementing the onlyOwner access control modifier.
Untrusted caller address compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Mapping of addresses to allow/deny permission flags in the Allow contract.
Array of all addresses that have been granted access, used for enumeration.
Empty constructor of the Allow contract.
Owner-only function granting allow permission to an address and appending it to allowedArray.
Owner-only function revoking allow permission from an address.
require(allowedMap[msg.sender] == true) guard implementing the allow modifier.
Untrusted caller address used as lookup key in allowedMap inside the allow modifier.
Parameter _address of allowAccess, the address being granted permission.
Parameter _address of denyAccess, the address being revoked permission.
State write allowedMap[_address] = true that grants permission.
Push of _address into allowedArray when the address is not already present.
Local boolean flags whether _address is already present in allowedArray.
Loop index iterating over allowedArray to detect duplicates.
Untrusted caller address emitted as the handler in the AddressAllowed event.
Untrusted caller address emitted as the handler in the AddressDenied event.
State write allowedMap[_address] = false that revokes permission.
Array of bytes32 hashes registered as copyright records.
Allow-guarded function that appends a hash to the list and emits SetLog.
View function returning the number of stored hashes.
Parameter _hash of save, the bytes32 record being registered.
Push of _hash into the list state array inside save.

edges.reason: Untrusted msg.sender flows into the privileged owner assignment in the constructor.
Ownable constructor executes the owner = msg.sender state write.
Constructor assignment writes the owner state variable.
owner state variable is read inside the onlyOwner require check.
Untrusted msg.sender compared against owner in the onlyOwner require.
onlyOwner modifier guard restricts execution of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guard restricts execution of allowAccess.
onlyOwner modifier guard restricts execution of denyAccess.
Untrusted msg.sender is the lookup key in the allow modifier require.
allow modifier guard restricts execution of save.
allowAccess performs the allowedMap permission write.
allowAccess performs the allowedArray push.
denyAccess performs the allowedMap permission revocation.
_address parameter is used as the key of the allowedMap write.
_address parameter is pushed into allowedArray.
allowedMap state variable is updated by the permission write.
allowedArray state variable is updated by the push.
Loop index i reads the length and elements of allowedArray.
exists flag conditionally gates the push into allowedArray.
_address parameter is used as the key of the deny write.
allowedMap state variable is updated by the revocation write.
msg.sender is emitted as handler in the AddressAllowed event of allowAccess.
msg.sender is emitted as handler in the AddressDenied event of denyAccess.
Allow constructor initializes the contract holding allowedMap state.
_hash parameter flows into the push operation.
save executes the push of the hash into the list.
list state variable is updated by the push.
count reads the length of the list state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter whose only role is to feed the transferOwnership ownership reassignment, so it is normalized into that core function.
_address parameter is used directly as the key of the allowedMap permission write, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
_address parameter is used directly as the key of the allowedMap revocation write, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The exists local flag only guards whether the push into allowedArray happens, so it normalizes into the push unsafe operation.
Loop index i only drives the duplicate scan inside allowAccess and has no independent semantic identity, so it merges into that core function.
_hash parameter is consumed solely by the list push in save, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
